module: "Variables" window (fg_variables) of the Flowgraph editor. It shows the variables of the current graph (mgr.graph.variables) and those of the project (mgr.variables) as expandable cards, with the short value, a variable editor, creation of a getter (types/getVariable) or setter (types/setVariable) node by click or drag and drop, and reordering by dragging.
notes: The node creation buttons are only active if mgr.allowEditing is true.
The new variable order is applied with changeCustomVariableOrder then a "Changed Variable Order" history entry.
drawGraph, drawRecursive and drawSortedGraphs are not called from draw() in this file (code available to display the variables of all graphs).

init.desc: Initializes the input fields, the drag and drop payload and registers the window.

draw.desc: Draws the "Current Graph Variables" header, the add button (addVariablePopup popup), the graph's variables then the project's.

getAutoTypeFromName.desc: Infers a variable type from a name via ui_flowgraph_editor.getAutoTypeFromName.

drawVariableCard.desc: Draws a variable's card: type icon, name, value, getter/setter buttons, drag handle and expanded editor.

drawTarget.desc: Draws all the variables of a container in customVariableOrder order and handles the drop to change the order.

drawGraph.desc: Draws the variables of a graph, with "(current)" if it is the current graph.

drawRecursive.desc: Draws a graph in a TreeNode then its children sorted by id.

drawSortedGraphs.desc: Recursively draws the root graphs (without parentId) of a table, sorted by id.
